pages.howIntro: Wenzy organises experiences designed to meet new people, without you having to organise anything.
pages.safetyText: Public places and verified partners, community rules accepted by every member, only useful details (first name, profile photo, interests) shared with your group, and you can report any behaviour after each experience.
pages.aboutText: We believe people connect better around a table, a yoga mat or a puzzle than through a screen. Wenzy was born in Casablanca to help everyone widen their circle, discover their city and break their routine.
pages.contactText: A question, a partnership idea or a place you'd like us to discover? Write to us.
pages.contactDemo: The contact form is enabled on the live site. Meanwhile, write to us by email.
pages.legalDraft: Document being drafted with our legal advisers (Law 09-08 and CNDP requirements). It will be published before bookings open.

pages.faqMore: More answers in the help centre
pages.step1Text: Universe, format, tier, day, time of day: filter the calendar. You can come alone, that's what it's made for.
pages.step2Text: Remaining spots are shown. Full? Join the waiting list: if a spot frees up, it's offered to you.
pages.step3Title: Help us put your group together
pages.step3Text: Your profile is enough for Tables (languages, interests, age); some activities have a short questionnaire, filled in before you pay. Diet and allergies to confirm for a meal.
pages.step4Title: Pay 35 DH, or use your pass
pages.step4Text: Online you only pay Wenzy: 35 DH per seat, nothing with the Pass, one credit with the Pack. The meal or activity is paid on site.
pages.step5Text: Instant confirmation, a reminder the day before, and the venue revealed 5 hours before (the evening before for morning and lunch). On site, check in: you'll meet your table and see first names.

faq.a1: No. Wenzy brings people together around experiences to make new friends and widen their circle.
faq.q2: Can I come on my own?
faq.a2: Yes, that's the whole idea: our events are designed for people coming alone. For Tables and group activities, we put the tables and teams together.
faq.a3: Based on your profile: languages, interests, ages and conversation style, avoiding always seating the same people together and anyone you asked not to be seated with again. Tables of 4 to 6; our team checks every composition.
faq.a4: Yes. The Wenzy fee (35 DH) is refunded according to the cancellation terms shown on each event before you book; the most common: full refund up to 48 hours before. You can also move your booking to another date until bookings close. If we cancel, you're refunded in full.
faq.q5: How old do I need to be?
faq.a5: Wenzy is for people aged 18 and over.
faq.a6: 35 DH online per seat (or nothing with the Pass, or one Pack credit). The rest is paid on site: what you eat and drink at the restaurant (the tier shows the budget), or the activity price shown on the page.
faq.a7: Each experience lists its languages (French, Darija, Arabic, English…). The languages in your profile help us put together groups where everyone can join the conversation.
faq.q8: I have a dietary requirement or an allergy: what should I do?
faq.a8: Tell us when you book, under “For your welcome”: diet, allergies and preferred languages. With your consent, we pass it on to the venue so it can prepare. You can change it from your booking until the experience starts.
faq.q9: How do the Pass and the Pack work?
faq.a9: The Pass (1 week to 1 year) includes your seat in every booking, with early access and members-only events; up to 2 upcoming bookings, and no check-in = no-show. The Pack (70 DH) gives 3 outings, 1 of them free, valid for 3 months. One-off payment, no automatic renewal.
faq.a10: You can leave at any time. Talk to the venue staff or our team, and report any inappropriate behaviour: we handle every report. All our experiences take place in public venues. See the Safety page.

aboutPage.storyP1: Wenzy started from something we had all noticed: Casablanca has no shortage of places — cafés, gyms, restaurants — yet really meeting someone is still hard, especially when you are new in town or want to widen your circle.
aboutPage.storyP2: We started with small tables of strangers. Very quickly, requests outnumbered the seats available.
aboutPage.storyP3: Today our team puts the groups together, chooses the venues and takes care of every detail so that everyone finds their place. One table at a time.
aboutPage.value1: A welcome by your first name, introductions: nobody is left on their own.
aboutPage.value2: Carefully curated groups that never get too big: the community grows naturally rather than just bigger.
aboutPage.value3: Dinner, brunch, workshop or simply conversation: each gathering starts from a venue or a shared interest.
aboutPage.value4: A good gathering is one where you leave with someone you'll want to see again, outside our events.
aboutPage.storyPhotoAlt: A group of participants laughing together around a table

aboutPage.heroPhotoAlt: Participants laughing together around a table
aboutPage.toolsTitle: Our tools for bringing people together
aboutPage.toolsText: Digital tools serving real-life encounters and friendships.
aboutPage.tool1: No profiles to scroll, no online chat to start. Our tool puts balanced groups together, whether it's a table or a team (languages, ages, interests); our team reviews them, and you meet in person.
aboutPage.tool3: For some formats, you send a request: the team puts the group together, and you only pay once your spot is accepted.
aboutPage.tool4: Full? Sign up: if a spot opens, you're told and can book it before anyone else.
aboutPage.tool5: Diet, allergies, preferred languages: add them when booking and we pass them on to the venue with your consent. When you arrive, check in in the app: your group appears so you can find each other.
aboutPage.tool6: A reminder the day before, then the venue revealed 5 hours before with the address. If anything changes, you're told straight away.
aboutPage.tool7: The Pass includes your seat, with early access; the Pack gives one outing free in three.
aboutPage.tool8: After each experience, leave a review: your feedback helps us choose venues and put better groups together.
aboutPage.galleryText: Smiles, new encounters and real connections. These are the moments when strangers come together and share something real.
aboutPage.galleryAlt: A shared moment at a Wenzy experience ({n})
aboutPage.tool2_card: Choose a universe and a date, pay by card on a secure payment page: your spot is confirmed right away.
aboutPage.tool2_bank_transfer: Choose a universe and a date, pay by bank transfer with your unique reference: your spot is confirmed as soon as the payment arrives.
aboutPage.tool2_none: Choose a universe and a date, book your spot: it's confirmed right away.

organizerPage.title: Become an organiser
organizerPage.intro: Do you run workshops, sports outings, tours or evenings? Publish your dates on Wenzy and sell your places online to people who come to discover and meet others.
organizerPage.why1: You create your listings and dates from the organiser space; the team reviews them before they go live.
organizerPage.why2: Bookings, reminders and check-in are handled for you. Your participants pay you the activity price on site; Wenzy takes no commission: its fee (35 DH) is paid by the participant.
organizerPage.why3Title: People who come to meet others
organizerPage.why3: Curious members, often coming alone, who leave a review after each experience.
organizerPage.step1: Create your account and present your activity (supporting documents, insurance for physical activities).
organizerPage.step2: The team checks your application and opens your organiser space.
organizerPage.step3: Publish your activities and dates; each new listing is reviewed before going live.
organizerPage.step4: Participants book and pay online; you follow your sales and receive your payouts.

audiences.partnersText: On the dates you choose, we bring you a small group of people who don’	 know you yet. Everyone pays for their own order: you simply keep a table or a space free.
audiences.organizersText: Workshop, sports outing, tour, games night: publish your dates on Wenzy. Bookings, online payment and reminders are handled, so you can focus on the experience.

audiences.trustedText: You come often and have an idea for an outing? The team invites regular members to become trusted members: you propose an outing, we check it, then we publish it.
